question: Dog-Spirit, why did you help the old man?

lines: This is a page from a class seven science book.
Point a phone at it, and the drawing comes alive on the paper.
This is Living Textbook.
Science pages become lessons. Story pages become films. All on the paper itself.

scenes.label: 1  Gemini builds the lesson
lines: Gemini reads every word, number and picture on the page.
It builds a live simulation, and checks every number against the page.

scenes.label: 2  A tutor you can interrupt
lines: A Gemini Live tutor teaches it. Interrupt it any time, with your voice.

scenes.label: 3  What if?
lines: Change a number, and the page changes too.

scenes.label: 4  A quiz from the page
lines: Then a quiz, made from the page itself.

scenes.label: 5  A story page becomes a film
lines: Story pages come alive too.

scenes.label: 6  You choose what happens
lines: At the turning point, you choose what happens.

scenes.label: 7  Talk to the characters
lines: Then talk to the characters. They answer in their own voice.

scenes.label: 8  Made and checked by Google AI
lines: Every film is made by Google AI.
Gemini plans it, Nano Banana draws it in the book's own style, and Gemini Omni films it.
Then Gemini watches the film like a critic, and sends weak shots back to be made again.

scenes.label: 9  The same film for everyone
lines: Every page is remembered.
The next student who scans it, or any other page of the story, gets the same film in seconds.

scenes.label: 10  For classrooms and other apps
lines: On the web, students see their progress, and teachers make chapter films for the class.
Other learning apps can add it all with one line of code.
Living Textbook. Any page, alive.
Built with Gemini on Google Cloud.
